name: Com hen
summary: Com hen is cold rice with tiny clams from the Perfume River, herbs, bean sprouts, shrimp paste, roasted peanuts, and pork rind. Eat it on Hen Island. A stall price is check on arrival.
origin: Hue. Vietnam Tourism calls it a peasant plate of leftover rice and tiny clams from the Perfume River.
howToEat: Mix the rice with the clam, the herbs, and the shrimp paste. The national page does not name a utensil.
Eat it on Hen Island, across Ưng Bình bridge. The walk is under half an hour, and the island floods out of sight in high water.
A clock hour is check on arrival. Nothing on these pages makes it a dinner.
where: Hen Island (Cồn Hến), across Ưng Bình bridge. Chi Lăng and Bạch Đằng are the afternoon streets on the far side. Shop names from the national itinerary are not picks on this page.
seoTitle: Com hen in Hue — cold rice and clams on Hen Island
seoDescription: Cold rice with tiny river clams, herbs, and shrimp paste. Cross Ung Binh bridge to Hen Island. The island floods. A stall price is check on arrival.
